_doc: R34-12 (task #531) — CLEAN A/B re-gate of RemoteFreeRing shadow-head. Three regimes (favorable / near_full / overflow), before vs after. 'before' = git worktree at commit c9a3570bfa4393c4a8383be25c3654e1421c7671 (pre-shadow-head, parent of the F10 landing commit d38bf73), built into D:/dev/rust/sefer-r34-12-before with its own CARGO_TARGET_DIR (D:/dev/rust/.cargo-target-r34-12-before) so it never clobbers the main tree's binary. 'after' = current HEAD (includes F10 shadow-head + R34-6 ordering promotion), built in the main tree's target dir (D:/dev/rust/.cargo-target). BOTH arms use IDENTICAL feature sets ('alloc-global alloc-xthread internals') and IDENTICAL drain mechanism (direct tls_heap::current_for_trim + HeapCore::dbg_drain_all_rings, no bench-internals). The internals feature is a no-op visibility gate in the before tree (modules already pub) with zero runtime/codegen effect. See docs/perf/R34_12_REMOTE_RING_CLEAN_REGATE.md.
